title: Nine Miles of Mapping
subtitle: 城市与城镇 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市与城镇（社会服务与人际沟通·城市与城镇）
meta: 主题语境：城市与城镇（社会服务与人际沟通·城市与城镇）　|　核心词汇：city　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 city 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to map ① city she could not leave, and she said the mapping was the whole of the lesson. The ② city, meaning the place and not the people, was nine miles wide and was mapped by whoever came last; city, she said, is the only thing on a coast that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ city on that coast had the same gate, and the ④ city at the end, meaning the one the planners kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mapped properly. City, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ city was the whole of the century, meaning the crowd it carried and not the place. The ⑥ city, meaning the crowd and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody fears and nobody questions; city, he said, is either something you map or the only word that means both a place and a crowd. She said the crowd is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ city had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the gate. The ⑧ city of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of mapping; city, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ city I remember is the one at the end, which was mapped in 1966 and is still described as the noisiest in the county. A ⑩ city, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being mapped; every city, she said, is a crowd that has agreed to look like a place. She said the crowd was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 城市（指那个地方本身，与那些人相对）
C. 固定搭配：map a city 测绘一座城市
D. n. 城市（指那条海岸线上每一座）
E. n. 城市（指末尾那一座）
F. n. 人群（抽象：它承载的那片人流）
G. n. 那片人流（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The city, meaning the place and not the people
city was the whole of the century
the city had become a number in a report
The city of the whole thing
A city, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: map a city 意为“测绘一座城市”，1946 年母亲被派去测绘她走不出去的那座城市。
city 意为“城市、都市”，指那个地方本身而不是那些人，宽九英里，由最后来的人测绘。
city 指那条海岸线上每一座城市，每一座都是同样的城门。
city 指末尾那一座（规划者保留的那一座），是唯一有人认真测绘过的。
city 意为“人群”，抽象指它承载的那片人流，父亲说 city 就是那个世纪的全部。
city 为抽象用法，指那片人流本身，是一个世纪里人人都怕、却没人质疑的东西。
city 意为“城市、都市”，到 1961 年这座 city 成了报告里的一个数字。
city 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的测绘。
city 意为“城市”，我记得的是末尾那一座，1966 年测绘，至今仍被说成全县最喧闹的。
city 为抽象总称，祖母说一座城市是唯一会因为被认真测绘而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1946 年母亲被派去测绘她走不出去的那座城市，她说测绘才是这堂课的全部。（map a city）
那座城市，指的是那个地方本身而不是那些人，宽九英里，由最后来的人测绘。（city）
那条海岸线上每一座城市都是同样的城门。（city）
末尾那座城市，指的是规划者保留的那一座，是唯一有人认真测绘过的。（city）
父亲说 city 就是那个世纪的全部，指的是它承载的人流而不是那个地方。（city）
1971 年祖母说，一座城市是唯一会因为被认真测绘而变好的东西。（city）
answers: In 1946 my mother was sent to map city she could not leave, and she said the mapping was the whole of the lesson.
The city, meaning the place and not the people, was nine miles wide and was mapped by whoever came last.
Every city on that coast had the same gate.
The city at the end, meaning the one the planners kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mapped properly.
My father said city was the whole of the century, meaning the crowd it carried and not the place.
